metadata.title: मणिपुर : ताज़ा हालात और समाधान का फार्मूला | Manipur situation and formula to resolve the crisis
metadata.description: The Manipur government will start transporting essential commodities to the Kuki tribal-dominated hill districts of Churachandpur from Monday, August 28. The government has also assured that medical supplies would also be taken to the district with the health department undertaking aerial supply using BSF, Assam rifles and Manipur police. The critical highways to tribal Kuki-Zo areas have been blocked by Meitei groups. In retaliation, on August 21, a Kuki body reimposed its blockade on the Dimapur-Imphal highway.
